+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from . import types
+from .core import batch
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Option
+
+
+class ImmutableEnvironmentValues(Option):
+    """An :class:`~click.core.Option` that returns values split from an
+    environment variable as a tuple instead of a list.
+    """
+
+    def value_from_envvar(self, ctx: Context) -> t.Any | None:
+        """Normalize the value from the environment variable, if it exists."""
+        rv: str | None = self.resolve_envvar_value(ctx)
+
+        if rv is None:
+            return None
+
+        # Non-boolean flags are more liberal in what they accept. But a flag being a
+        # flag, its envvar value still needs to analyzed to determine if the flag is
+        # activated or not.
+        if self.is_flag and not self.is_bool_flag:
+            # If the flag_value is set and match the envvar value, return it
+            # directly.
+            if self.flag_value is not None and rv == self.flag_value:
+                return self.flag_value
+            # Analyze the envvar value as a boolean to know if the flag is
+            # activated or not.
+            return types.BoolParamType.str_to_bool(rv)
+
+        # Split the envvar value if it is allowed to be repeated.
+        value_depth = (self.nargs != 1) + bool(self.multiple)
+        if value_depth > 0:
+            multi_rv = self.type.split_envvar_value(rv)
+            if self.multiple and self.nargs != 1:
+                multi_rv = batch(multi_rv, self.nargs)  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+            return tuple(multi_rv)
+
+        return rv
diff --git a/tests/test_immutable_environment_values.py b/tests/test_immutable_environment_values.py
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_immutable_environment_values.py
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.immutable_environment_values import ImmutableEnvironmentValues
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kwargs", "env", "expect"),
+    [
+        ({"multiple": True}, "a b c", ("a", "b", "c")),
+        ({"nargs": 2}, "a b", ("a", "b")),
+        ({"multiple": True, "nargs": 2}, "a b c d", (("a", "b"), ("c", "d"))),
+        ({}, "a b", "a b"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_value_from_envvar(monkeypatch, kwargs, env, expect):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ARG", env)
+    opt = ImmutableEnvironmentValues(["--arg"], envvar="ARG", **kwargs)
+
+    with click.Context(click.Command("cli")) as ctx:
+        assert opt.value_from_envvar(ctx) == expect
+
+
+def test_value_from_envvar_missing(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("ARG", raising=False)
+    opt = ImmutableEnvironmentValues(["--arg"], envvar="ARG", multiple=True)
+
+    with click.Context(click.Command("cli")) as ctx:
+        assert opt.value_from_envvar(ctx) is None
